blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—The ₱357 million Grand Lotto 6/55 jackpot drawn on Wednesday, Nov. 11, 2026, was not won by bettors, as shown by the results of the major draws that day of the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO). The Grand Lotto 6/55 draw produced the winning combination 19-04-27-54-22-48, with a jackpot prize of ₱357 million, according to the PCSO results. No ticket matched all six numbers. READ: Lotto results for Nov. 11, 2026 Aside from the Grand Lotto, no bettor also won the Mega Lotto 6/45’s P15 million jackpot for the Wednesday draw, which yielded the winning combination of 25-37-01-44-10-31.
